description: Explains what Ridekick does, what dealerships see, how prices work, what to tell a buyer when Ridekick isn't connected, is disconnected or stops working, and the rules for using Ridekick's tools. It needs no sign-in and reads nothing about the buyer. It answers questions about how Ridekick works and about a tool that stops working. It is not needed before you search, preview or send a request: those tools return a message for the buyer when they refuse. In every Ridekick answer, `buyerLine` is the sentence for the buyer, as Ridekick wrote it. A label that starts with "Test:" is a test row, and none of it is real. Unless a tool says otherwise, `id` is the id of a request from requests_list, and `rowKey` is the row key of one dealership from requests_get.
name: how_ridekick_works
title: How Ridekick works
